title: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs doc says 'currently not produced by decrypt()' — confusing because agree_ecdh IS used
description: key.rs: KeyEncryptionAlgorithm::EcdhEs doc says 'Reserved; currently not produced by decrypt(). See type-level doc.' and the type-level doc explains ECDH decryption uses agree_ecdh(). The variant exists but is never constructed by this crate. A new contributor reading the code will be confused: why is EcdhEs in KeyEncryptionAlgorithm if it is never used? The doc should say explicitly: 'This variant is never returned by decrypt(); it exists as an extension point for external callers.' Alternatively, remove the variant if it has no current users.
